The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ce7a208ddd7ef666), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 23. statement: Suppose Fo : U × Rr → R is a smooth Morse family, with ΓFo a diffeomorphism onto its generated Lagrangian Lo ⊂ T∗U. Suppose that it is smooth up to U, with uniform bounds on compact vertical sets, and equals a homogeneous function go(x, w) for ∥w∥ ≥ Ro, where go is smooth for w ̸= 0 and ∥∇wgo(x, w)∥ ≥ co∥w∥, ∥dxgo(x, w)∥ ≤ Co∥w∥2 , co > 0. (43) For a small step ψ as in Lemma 6.2, there is a smooth Morse family on U × Rr+2d generating ψ(Lo) with the same properties. Its critical locus corresponds diffeomorphically to Crit(Fo). On every fixed compact parameter slice in U, its homogeneous data represent the split quadratic stabilization of the preceding tube class.
